verdicts.reason: Both fail the same way: the diamond photo mosaic becomes one small square photo next to an empty white lattice of diamond outlines. The date diamond overlaps the photo's bottom edge, the address and date text is tiny, and the body copy is very small. A breaks the headline cleanly as 'SAVE / YOUR CITY', but its divider rule floats on its own under the empty lattice and the URL is pressed against the right edge. B leaves 'CITY' alone on the second line of the headline, and its rule and vertical URL are tucked awkwardly between the left diamond and the photo, so A is slightly less bad.
